sinopsis: Lin Wanxing keluar dari penjara setelah tiga tahun dan masuk ke Grup Shengshi sebagai petugas kebersihan. Di lobi ia dipermalukan Su Tian — sampai liontin giok di lehernya terlihat oleh CEO Gu Chenzhou, dan seluruh ruangan berhenti.
catatanPenulisan: Dialog ditulis Mandarin lebih dulu, baru diterjemahkan. Terjemahan Indonesia sengaja TIDAK harfiah pada kalimat sarkastis — drama pendek Tiongkok mengandalkan nada, dan terjemahan kaku membunuh adegannya. `pinyin` disertakan untuk pemeriksaan pelafalan oleh mesin suara. Kolom `fokus` menentukan seberapa rinci tokoh dideskripsikan ke mesin gambar: "wajah" = deskripsi penuh (untuk close-up), "adegan" = ringkas (untuk wide/medium, supaya seluruh badan & latar ikut tergambar), "objek" = tokoh tidak dideskripsikan sama sekali (untuk close-up benda seperti liontin, supaya wajah tidak merebut bingkai).

shot.aksi: she walks out through the heavy iron gate alone, carrying a thin cloth bag, she does not look back

dialog.mandarin: 三年前，我被所有人丢掉了。
dialog.pinyin: Sān nián qián, wǒ bèi suǒyǒu rén diūdiào le.
dialog.indonesia: Tiga tahun lalu, semua orang membuangku.

shot.kamera: extreme close-up on her open palm
shot.aksi: her fingers slowly uncurl to reveal a white jade teardrop pendant resting in her palm

dialog.mandarin: 三年后，我带着证据回来了。
dialog.pinyin: Sān nián hòu, wǒ dài zhe zhèngjù huílái le.
dialog.indonesia: Tiga tahun kemudian, aku kembali membawa bukti.

shot.aksi: series title appears over the glass tower

shot.kamera: low angle wide, slow tilt up
shot.aksi: the glass headquarters tower rises against an overcast sky, traffic blurs at its base
in a faded grey janitor uniform she mops the black marble floor, head down, invisible to the people walking past
she sweeps in with two assistants and kicks over the mop bucket, water spreading across the marble

dialog.mandarin: 哟，这不是我们林大小姐吗？
dialog.pinyin: Yō, zhè bù shì wǒmen Lín dà xiǎojiě ma?
dialog.indonesia: Wah, bukankah ini Nona Besar Lin kita?

shot.kamera: high angle looking down at her
shot.aksi: she kneels and wipes the spilled water in silence while the other woman stands over her

dialog.mandarin: 跪着的样子，比三年前顺眼多了。
dialog.pinyin: Guì zhe de yàngzi, bǐ sān nián qián shùnyǎn duō le.
dialog.indonesia: Berlutut begitu jauh lebih enak dilihat daripada tiga tahun lalu.

shot.aksi: her eyes stay dry and perfectly still, no tears, only calculation
the private lift opens and he strides out with his assistant half a step behind, the entire lobby falls silent
her face flips instantly from cruelty to sweetness as she steps forward
he walks straight past her without turning his head, she is left holding her smile at nothing
he halts mid-stride, his gaze locked on the kneeling woman whose collar has fallen open

shot.kamera: extreme close-up, shallow focus, memory flash
shot.aksi: the same jade pendant swings in the rain above a shattered windscreen, a bloodied hand reaching
he seizes her wrist and pulls her to her feet, the lobby frozen around them

dialog.mandarin: 这个东西，你从哪儿拿的？
dialog.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi, nǐ cóng nǎr ná de?
dialog.indonesia: Benda ini — dari mana kau dapat?

shot.kamera: close-up on her, slow push in
shot.aksi: she lifts her head for the first time and looks directly into his eyes without flinching

dialog.pinyin: Gù zǒng, nín nòng téng wǒ le.

shot.kamera: close-up, she pulls her wrist free
shot.aksi: she twists her wrist free and tucks the pendant back under her collar, her voice dropping

dialog.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ de. Yīzhí dōu shì.

shot.aksi: his cold composure cracks for a single frame

shot.kamera: slow push to extreme close-up, cut to black
shot.aksi: the faintest smile touches her mouth as she answers, then the screen cuts hard to black

dialog.pinyin: Yī gè lái tǎo zhài de rén.
